confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or 2026 menus. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail and wine were set at roughly 2.5 to 3 times the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weaker for those items. Accommodation assumes July rainy-season (low-season) rates including Thai VAT and any service charge, and is the least certain, especially the 3-star and private hostel figures. The FX value comes from search results surfacing the RBA daily rates, not a direct read of the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single city was used as a direct comparable. The basis is general Thai secondary tourist-city price levels, somewhat below Bangkok's central tourist districts, with Chiang Mai's cafe, guesthouse and mid-range restaurant market as the reference point. Estimates were reasoned in Thai baht and converted at approximate recent rates.
